positions.title: Software Engineer - P2
positions.description:
* Aided in developing Zoom Events OpenAPI for external developers to integrate their onsite / hybrid events into our virtual event platform
* Helped architect a micro-service solution to detect and block copyrighted music from being played during a Zoom Event Conference to help protect our platform from illegal music streaming
* Developed integrations between Zoom Events and key partner companies
* Implemented new testing practices into our existing Zoom Events projects, which included updated unit tests with coverage reports, integration tests to be used to validate new versions of our environment, as well as Selenium based UI Tests to walk through major UI flows and assure proper functionality for users

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Aided in implementing a reusable integration with our LMS and plagiarism solutions allowing instructors to quickly and easily compare students essays to major online databases 
* Architected a technical solution that allowed students to track their progress through a course and that displayed that data for their instructors
* Performed performance testing on newly developed features to assure a consistent user experience for our customers

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Architected a Spring Boot microservice to retrieve customer data, saving developers in my organization over an hour a day during testing.
* Streamlined an internal automation tools querying functionality returning searches on average 70% quicker.
* Containerized one of my team's production applications aiding in future deployment pipelines.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: During my studies at Purdue University, I continued my intern project to help transform the IT Atlas allowing SEs and Customers to better understand their IT infrastructure. I also created an internal tool for the LAUNCH team to help in the onboarding and progression tracking of the new hires.

positions.title: Systems Engineer Intern
positions.description: During the Summer of 2018, I had the great experience of an internship as a Pre-Sales Systems Engineer at Dell EMC. Throughout the Summer, my team and I created a collaborative website for current Systems Engineers in our field to keep updated on their clients, current and future, IT infrastructure. We also got to spend time learning about the Dell Technologies portfolio and practice our presentation and whiteboarding skills.

positions.title: XTern Bootcamp
positions.description: XTern boot camp is a summer experience for starting professionals to learn the basics of web development and to build our professional portfolios for future internships. During the boot camp, my peers and I learned HTML, CSS, and Javascript with a focus on React.js. We also received training in Scrum and Agile Frameworks.

honors.title: Purdue University Deans List
honors.description: WIth my high academic standing I was placed onto the Dean's List for Purdue.

projects.title: IT Atlas
projects.description: During my systems engineering internship at Dell EMC, my team and I created a collaborative internal website for Systems Engineers to use to layout customers IT infrastructure and keep track of their team and their client's teams roles during the sales process. This project has received much praise from the original creator of the first IT Atlas and also the SVP of Enterprise Solutions.

projects.title: Scribe Scholars
projects.description: During my software engineering course at Purdue, my team and I created an all-inclusive classroom website with everything for homework and quizzes to live dashboard of statistics for teachers and educational games for the students.
